newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Recovering Yeltsin off lung ventilator - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Recovering Yeltsin off lung ventilator - Kremlin.

text.p: Doctors took Russian President Boris Yeltsin off a lung ventilator on Wednesday morning, the Kremlin press service said.

It was another sign that the 65-year-old Russian leader was recovering well from Tuesday's seven-hour quintuple heart bypass operation. He has already taken back full presidential powers, delegated to Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin during surgery.
